name: Delivery to Ridgewell
label: Quest
description: Delivery to Ridgewell: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have packaged Doomriggers Clasp into a crate, suitable for shipment to Stormwind. Friend, you have been extremely helpful -- can I ask you for one last favor?
Deliver the crate to Count Remington Ridgewell. You will find him in the Keep of Stormwind. I am sure he'll be very pleased to see what you have for him.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I was told a messenger would come. One with a gift from Blackrock Spire.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, so you are they! You have my thanks, friend. And... If you didn't already know... The gratitude of a noble in the house of Ridgewell is nigh worth a king's ransom.
